concept.title: Securing a Child Restraint System with the “ISOFIX top tether anchorage” system

li.p: Route the ISOFIX top tether strap over the seatback.
Connect the ISOFIX top tether strap to the ISOFIX top tether anchorage and tighten the ISOFIX top tether strap according to the CRS manufacturer’s instructions.
Route the ISOFIX top tether strap over the seatback.
Connect the ISOFIX top tether strap to the ISOFIX top tether anchorage.
Tighten the ISOFIX top tether strap according to the instructions of your Child Restraint System’s manufacturer.

note.p: Take the following precautions when installing the ISOFIX top tether strap:

li.p: Read and follow all installation instructions provided with your Child Restraint System.
NEVER attach more than one Child Restraint System to a single ISOFIX top tether anchorage. This could cause the anchorage or attachment to come loose or break.
Do not attach the ISOFIX top tether strap to anything other than the correct ISOFIX top tether anchorage. It may not work properly if attached to something else.

Child restraint anchorages are designed to withstand only those loads imposed by correctly fitted child restraints. Under no circumstances are they to be used for adult seatbelts, harnesses, or for attaching other items or equipment to the vehicle.
